title: Waamicha Dhaabbata Hin Qabne Biyya Of Tuulummaa Keessatti
intro: Diigama qaroomina yeroo tokko guddaa ture, bakka aangoo fi of tuuluun daangaa hin beekne keessa dhaabbatta. Ergamaan tokko gara dhugaatti waamaa isaan gidduu adeemaa ture, garuu garaan isaanii jabaate. Akeekkachiisni sun osoo hin dhaggeeffatamne, samiin mataan isaa meeshaa dheekkamsaa ta’e. Ergamaan kun eenyu ture, warri waamicha dide maal ta'e?
clues: Ummata humnaan gita hin qabnee fi iddoo olka’aa hunda irratti siidaa ijaare tokkotti ergame.
Sabni koo akka nama hin mo’amneetti of ilaalee, ‘Eenyutu humnaan nu caala?’ jedhe.
Rabbiin qofa akka gabbaraniif isaan waame, garuu gowwummaa fi soba na himatan.
Yoon dhugaa dubbadhe adabbii waadaa gale akkan fidu na morman.
Rabbiin qilleensi gogaa homaa itti hin dhufne isaan irratti erge.
Anaafi warri na waliin amanan rahmata Rabbiitiin kan fayyine yoo ta’u, kaafiroonni garuu guutummaatti balleessan.

outcome.label: Bu'aa
options: Hud fi amantoonni fayyan, kaafiroonnis ni balleeffaman
Hud gara buufata olka'aa tokkotti ol guddate
Sabni Hud qalbii diddiirratanii ni oolaniiru
Hud adabbii kamiinuu dura saba isaa dhiisee deeme
outcome.answer: Hud fi amantoonni fayyan, kaafiroonnis ni balleeffaman

arabic: فَأَنجَيْنَـٰهُ وَٱلَّذِينَ مَعَهُۥ بِرَحْمَةٍۢ مِّنَّا وَقَطَعْنَا دَابِرَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا ۖ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُؤْمِنِينَ
verse: So We saved him and those with him by mercy from Us. And We eliminated those who denied Our signs, and they were not [at all] believers. (7:72)
